title: Gemini's new 2.5 flash image generator model
author: recallingmemories
selftext: Seems pretty good for generating quick 2d assets - they're saying it's really useful for [character consistency](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini/image/). You can access it through their AI studio.

comments.author: neomeddah
comments.body:
I had to go through hundreds of icons in [itch.io](http://itch.io) lately and let me tell you, what gemini is doing is straightforward plagiarism. It acted as a clever search engine but presented to you as if generated content. 

I know all I results are in a level of plagiarism but come on, this is not even trying.

replies.author: recallingmemories
replies.body:
None of the art it generated here is that ground breaking though. That potion top-left has been drawn a million times over by different people, but no one would say they plagiarized it from the first person who drew it.

Also, I could just take these as generated assets as inspiration and draw my own.. the same way I take inspiration from existing games out there.

replies.author: neomeddah
replies.body: you are absolutely right I am just expecting better from the models, I am struggling with 2d asset generation as well and I ended up starting drawing my own for some.

replies.author: recallingmemories
replies.body: You can also hand-draw assets you want on paper, load a picture of it into Gemini, and then prompt it for a pixel art rendering. Take that, and use it as inspiration.. etc.
